deck.ko: 장갑에 내려앉은 낙엽을 털어 내는 늦가을 오후의 따뜻한 차림.
deck.en: Brushing a fallen leaf off his glove on a late-autumn afternoon.
deck.de: Ein Herbstblatt vom Handschuh wischen, an einem späten Herbstnachmittag.

intro.ko: 자전거 거치대 옆, 낙엽이 장갑 위로 떨어지자 고개를 숙여 털어 냅니다. 초콜릿 코듀로이와 버건디 스카프가 흩날리는 잎 색과 겹쳐 보입니다.
intro.en: By the bike racks a leaf lands on his glove and he bends to brush it off. Chocolate corduroy and a burgundy scarf echo the colours of the falling leaves.
intro.de: An den Fahrradständern landet ein Blatt auf seinem Handschuh, er wischt es weg. Schokobrauner Cord und ein bordeauxroter Schal greifen die Farben des fallenden Laubs auf.

body.ko: 버건디 프린지 스카프까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with burgundy fringed scarf.

pull.en: Dark olive jacket with brown collar

copy.pullQuoteEn: Dark olive jacket with brown collar

tip.ko: 갈색 바지와 갈색 부츠 사이에 색 차이를 조금 두면 아래가 한 덩어리로 무거워 보이지 않아요.
tip.en: Keep a slight shade difference between brown trousers and brown boots so the lower half doesn't read as one heavy block.
tip.de: Zwischen brauner Hose und braunen Stiefeln einen kleinen Farbunterschied lassen, damit die untere Hälfte nicht schwer wirkt.

ko.deck: 브라운 칼라 다크 올리브 재킷에 크림색 텍스처 니트을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Dark olive jacket with brown collar over cream textured knit for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Dunkelolivgrüne Jacke mit braunem Kragen über Cremefarbener Strukturstrickpullover für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.
